_note: Company voice (Oct 23 2026, coder; Gary 12:19 / 12:20 / 12:21 PM CT). The company's comms line chimes in after milestones and discoveries, always addressing the player by employee number ({employee_id}). Structure reference only (employee + tiered clearance + corporate assistant); every name and line is ours. Read by src/systems/company_voice.js. Lines: text/overworld_lines.json system_company_voice.<line> (Text Bot owns it; brief: data/textbot_requests_company_voice.md); the code has neutral fallbacks. tier: 'milestone' = shown in Milestones-only mode, 'full' = Full mode only. priority: highest wins inside one burst (max 1 message per burst). cooldownMs: the same event is dropped if it fired that recently. once: 'event' = once per save, 'key' = once per save per key (map / flag / count / level / node rank), false = every time (cooldown only).
_release_note: Release scope (Gary 12:45 PM CT Oct 23 2026: "Yes, ship RITA in region 1"; ?cv=0 turns it off). maxRegion = highest region shipped. A system_company_voice line (base, variant or specific key) whose 'region' tag is above maxRegion is never used (specific key -> generic region 1 family -> code fallback). kilindex_milestone fires only the counts in counts_by_region for regions <= maxRegion; quest_done fires only the quest ids in keys_by_region for regions <= maxRegion (an event without keys_by_region is open). Raise maxRegion and add the next region's lists when region 2 ships.
_start_note: RITA install (Gary 3:58 / 3:59 PM CT Oct 23 2026): the lab tech installs her during the tutorial, before the starter pick (intro.js ritaInstall sets rita_installed, then emits rita_install = her first strip, the Trainer 1 intro). Was got_starter; old saves with got_starter or cv#trainer1 seen are marked installed automatically (company_voice.js started()).

duck._note: Music duck while RITA's strip is up (Gary 1:41 PM CT Oct 23 2026: "music should turn down to let her talk"). music = fraction of the player's music volume (0.35 = about -9 dB); fades in ms; maxMs = fallback release. Music only (not effects / master); muted or music 0 = no duck. Remove this block (or music 1) to turn it off. src/audio/audio.js duck() / unduck().

speaker.portrait_note: RITA portrait v1 (Gary 1:41 PM CT Oct 23: "RITA is a girl give it a different model" / "a woman" / "in a red dress" / "brown hair"). Generated by Coder in the NPC portrait style, oval 329x512 RGBA.
